plain_english: Stain-washing books exist, and their crossers too — yogins, scholars stand healthy — but devotees alone, in truth.
sanskrit_cite: trimalakṣālino granthāḥ santi tatpāragāstathā yoginaḥ paṇḍitāḥ svasthās tvadbhaktā eva tattvataḥ

plain_english: Māyā-time-limit-passion and the rest as food, fully fed — devotees stroll happy, Lord, on the world's shore.
sanskrit_cite: māyīyakālaniyatirāgādyāhāratarpitāḥ caranti sukhino nātha bhaktimanto jagattaṭe

plain_english: Laughing or crying, they babble You aloud — devotees, whose praise-word offerings are ornaments apart.
sanskrit_cite: rudanto vā hasanto vā tvām uccaiḥ pralapanty amī bhaktāḥ stutipadoccāropacārāḥ pṛthag eva te

plain_english: Not detached, not master, not liberation-desiring is Your worshipper — but drunk with soaring devotion-liquor-rasa.
sanskrit_cite: na virakto na cāpīśo mokṣākāṅkṣī tvadarcakaḥ bhaveyam api tūdriktabhaktyāsavarasonmadaḥ

plain_english: Who worships by drawing the outer inside the heart alone — to him, in devotion-nectar floods, I bow.
sanskrit_cite: bāhyaṃ hṛdaya evāntar abhihṛtyaiva yo 'rcati tvām īśa bhaktipīyūṣarasapūrair namāmi tam

plain_english: Between dharma and adharma acts, knowledges, pleasure and pain selves — devotees taste SOMETHING — ah!
sanskrit_cite: dharmādharmātmanor antaḥ kriyayor jñānayos tathā sukhaduḥkhātmanor bhaktāḥ kim apy āsvādayanty aho

plain_english: Blind ones, lepers even — they shine, supreme, ornamented by blazing devotion to You.
sanskrit_cite: carācarapitaḥ svāmin apy andhā api kuṣṭhinaḥ śobhante param uddāmabhavadbhaktivibhūṣaṇāḥ

plain_english: Gleaners, winnowers, enemies' shadows even — yet by devotion's heat they rule even the king of kings.
sanskrit_cite: śiloñchapicchakaśipuvicchāyāṅgā api prabho bhavadbhaktimahoṣmaṇo rājarājam apīśate

plain_english: Though rolling in nectar-wet devotion, yet wanting to climb — some worship You with mind alone, standing all around.
sanskrit_cite: sudhārdrāyāṃ bhavadbhaktau luṭhatāpy ārurukṣuṇā cetasaiva vibho 'rcanti kecit tvām abhitaḥ sthitāḥ

plain_english: To be guarded, grown, honored, Lord — this great wealth of devotion that ends bad rebirths.
sanskrit_cite: rakṣaṇīyaṃ vardhanīyaṃ bahumānyam idaṃ prabho saṃsāradurgatiharaṃ bhavadbhaktimahādhanam

plain_english: Lord, though Your devotees love You — abandoning jealousy toward Her, may She always be pleased, the Mistress.
sanskrit_cite: nātha te bhaktajanatā yady api tvayi rāgiṇī tathāpīrṣyāṃ vihāyāsyās tuṣṭāstu svāminī sadā

plain_english: Your future being first; when devotion's occasion comes and the milk-ocean is churned — curd-greed is killed.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadbhāvaḥ puro bhāvī prāpte tvadbhaktisambhave labdhe dugdhamahākumbhe hatā dadhani gṛdhnutā

plain_english: Is this not attainment beyond compare — ever-growing devotion to Śambhu, always new? What happiness does it not stream?
sanskrit_cite: kim iyaṃ na siddhir atulā kiṃ vā mukhyaṃ na saukhyam āsravati bhaktir upacīyamānā yeyaṃ śambhoḥ sadātanī bhavati

plain_english: Sunk in my dirty mind, Your devotion gem-creeper — alas — does not spread its own splendor's unfoldings.
sanskrit_cite: manasi maline madīyemagnā tvadbhaktimaṇilatā kaṣṭam na nijān api tanute tānapauruṣeyān svasampadullāsān

plain_english: Devotion to the Lord of three worlds IS supreme attainment — but lacking supernormal powers, is it not full? — that is my worry.
sanskrit_cite: bhaktir bhagavati bhavati trilokanāthe nanūttamā siddhiḥ kiṃ tv aṇimādikavirahāt saiva na pūrṇeti cintā me

plain_english: Outside and in, the fragrance of Your praise-blossoms' opening perfumes even hostile ascetics dwelling near.
sanskrit_cite: bāhyato 'ntar api cotkaṭonmiṣattryambakastavakasaurabhāḥ śubhāḥ vāsayanty api viruddhavāsanān yogino nikaṭavāsino 'khilān

plain_english: By no account is there any light; the whole world fast asleep — yet at Your Śivarātri post, devotees always worship You.
sanskrit_cite: jyotir asti kathayāpi na kiṃ cid viśvam apy atisuṣuptam aśeṣam yatra nātha śivarātripade 'smin nityam arcayati bhaktajanas tvām

plain_english: Let goodness expand in true worship of gracious Śiva; let Śaṅkara-foot-dust heaps sport on the crown — to cut even passion-memories, let darkness swell, or the triple world dissolve in Your self-loss.
sanskrit_cite: sattvaṃ satyaguṇe śive bhagavati sphārībhavatv arcane cūḍāyāṃ vilasantu śaṅkarapadaprodyadrajaḥsaṅcayāḥ rāgādismṛtivāsanām api samucchettuṃ tamo jṛmbhatāṃ śambho me bhavatāt tvadātmavilaye traiguṇyavargo 'thavā

plain_english: The world-road is long; limbs burnt by harsh diseases; pleasures unenjoyed; happiness never long — thus I have become useless, moon-crest-foot-pressed, wholly Yours — so make me, quickly, long-and-rich in great fortune, as Your devotee.
sanskrit_cite: saṃsārādhvā sudūraḥ kharataravividhavyādhidagdhāṅgayaṣṭiḥ bhogā naivopabhuktā yad api sukham abhūj jātu nanno cirāya itthaṃ vyartho 'smi jātaḥ śaśidharacaraṇākrāntikāntottamāṅgas tvadbhaktaś ceti tan me kuru sapadi mahāsampado dīrghadīrghāḥ
